scope: Source-local fixed bookkeeping anchor, exact root/tenant and aggregate binding, immutable-source-sized projection slot commitments, inventory arithmetic and recovery-only inventory checks. Attempt budget record storage remains with its frozen Target owner outside its internal commitment. No production inventory reader/writer or protected deletion; other business record ownership and incarnation lifecycle remain incomplete.

provedContractProperties: One fixed root anchor, aggregate and both root counter records contribute fixed storage commitments only once through the primary root; mirror usage is never an additional aggregate source.

Projection slot size is independent of usage/revision values and uses immutable physical source length, reserving optional Kafka epoch and full Pulsar UTF-8 identity bounds. No recursive encoded-usage fixed point or filesystem size sampling.
Closed NV 31 / meta 18 anchor stores full root/tenant/accounting, three inventory counts and independent source revision; ordinary same-key updates do not allocate slots.
Zero retired counters and zero totals remain counted; inventory audit rejects duplicate/missing/foreign projection records and missing or undercharged root/mirror.
Actual non-genesis aggregate must bind the exact root incarnation, cover the projection commitment, and have consistent source/sequence/digest. Inventory audit is not full ledger reconstruction.

Attempt budget record fee is separate from commitment/allocated, uses its own frozen accounting, and remains unchanged through all five phases including RELEASED. It is still charged to its original Target identity until protected actual deletion.
Checked subtraction before addition, root minimum, multiplication/total overflow and replay/source replacement/exhaustion fail without mutations.
Independent Kafka/Pulsar/epoch/populated vectors, maximum 1 MiB Pulsar source and raw revision digest, UTF-8 bounds and actual encoded counter/total/aggregate/activation/budget coverage checks.
Legacy NV reader rejects the valid new bookkeeping envelope; all previous quota foundations, grant verifier and active Lane storage code remain unchanged.
